mobile_service.coverage_rule: Take the convex hull of every vertex of the five official municipal boundaries and ZCTA 60035. Select a ZCTA if its intersection with this hull exceeds one square metre in EPSG:3857. Cover and shade the full original geometry of every selected ZCTA, including portions beyond the selection hull. No city-centre, centroid, prefix, or anchor-override selection.
mobile_service.additional_boundary: Every vertex of Census ZCTA 60035, as requested for Highland Park
mobile_service.lincoln_park: A Chicago neighborhood, already included by the full Chicago municipal boundary
mobile_service.map_note: All 206 selected ZCTAs are covered and highlighted in full, including their portions beyond the internal municipal envelope. The envelope only selects ZIPs and is not drawn. Full-region display expands the previous 51 edge ZIPs, including small-intersection areas such as 46327, 46394, 60120, and 60502. Every highlighted vertex fits the initial viewport. Unmatched or postal-only ZIPs require a call.

field_notes.usps_postal_locale: USPS postal facility locale, not necessarily the resident city.
field_notes.centroid_latitude: Census CENTLAT, retained for audit reference only; not used for selection.
field_notes.centroid_longitude: Census CENTLON, retained for audit reference only; not used for selection.
field_notes.coverage_status: full for every selected ZIP; outside for candidates not selected.
field_notes.selection_overlap: full, partial, or outside describes overlap with the internal selection envelope only; it does not restrict service within a selected ZIP.
field_notes.selection_intersection_fraction_projecte: Intersection area divided by source ZCTA area in EPSG:3857, retained for selection audit only; not a service-coverage percentage.

mobile_service.display_rule: Fill each selected ZCTA's complete original rings. Fit all highlighted geometry with at least 24 SVG units of padding; draw no outer selection perimeter.
